{{Conjecture}}
A '''crystal skull''' was supposedly sculpted from the ashes of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hero [[Newar Forrth]] who was the ruler and protector of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Newar's crystallized skull was used during events, celebrations and ceremonies like [[Jasshi'rr]], 
[[Keysshi]] and [[Waala]].<ref name="Idol Intentions">''{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}''</ref>
